remarks: Experience refined riverfront living in this stunning end-unit townhome, ideally located in Stamford's sought-after Glenbrook neighborhood. Thoughtfully designed with 9-foot ceilings, hardwood floors, and oversized windows, this sunlit home features high-end finishes and quality craftsmanship throughout. The open-concept main level impresses with a gourmet kitchen boasting marble countertops, ample cabinetry, and top-grade stainless steel appliances. The living room, complete with a gas fireplace and private balcony, seamlessly flows into the dining area, providing ideal space for entertaining. A conveniently well-appointed half bath completes the main level. Ascend to the upper level and retreat to your expansive primary suite, featuring its own private balcony, a spacious walk-in closet, and a spa-like bath with double vanity, soaking tub, and separate shower. Three additional generously sized bedrooms, two full bathrooms, and a dedicated laundry room complete the upper levels, offering comfort and functionality. The walk-out lower level adds even more versatility, featuring large windows, a half bath, and direct access to a patio overlooking the serene riverfront. An attached garage, close proximity to the Glenbrook train station, local shops, and restaurants make this exceptional home the perfect blend of elegance and convenience.
